title: CM Punk vs. MJF: hero worship turns poisonous
summary: MJF’s fixation on Punk becomes a feud of verbal attacks, deception, and a dog-collar reckoning.

chapters.title: MJF beats Punk in Chicago
chapters.result: MJF defeats Punk with help from Wardlow and the diamond ring.
chapters.context: Winning in Punk’s hometown gives MJF leverage in their rivalry.

chapters.title: Punk wins the dog-collar match
chapters.result: Punk defeats MJF after Wardlow leaves the ring available to him.
chapters.context: Wardlow’s defiance becomes part of Punk’s revenge.
